meta.description: Input covariances for the Homeostasis chapter's live explorer, and the stable parts of each on a theta grid (step 0.01). Part: support S (input indices), h on S (sums to 1), c = top eigenvalue of (Sigma - theta 11^T)_SS, lam = top eigenvalue of Sigma_SS, E = h^T Sigma h. method enum = exact enumeration of supports (B <= 16; tie = counts at theta -/+ 1e-6 where a part is marginal); flow = lone-neuron flow from 849 starts, endpoints checked exactly (a lower bound). See findings.md F1 for the stability criterion.

graded6.label: graded variances (diagonal, B = 6)
graded6.desc: independent inputs with variances 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3 (the allocation testbed of findings F6)

planted_energy.label: planted blocks, unequal energy (B = 12)
planted_energy.desc: 4 blocks of 3, within-block correlation 0.6, across 0, block variances 0.7, 1, 1.4, 2

planted_size.label: planted blocks, unequal size (B = 12)
planted_size.desc: blocks of 1, 2, 3 and 6 inputs, unit variance, within-block correlation 0.6, across 0

block12.label: block12: 3 blocks of 4 (B = 12)
block12.desc: 3 blocks of 4, unit variance, within 0.5, across 0.1 (the phase-diagram covariance)

hier8.label: hierarchical (B = 8)
hier8.desc: ultrametric: siblings 0.6, cousins 0.3, halves 0.05, unit variance

ring16.label: ring (B = 16)
ring16.desc: 16 inputs on a ring, Sigma = exp(-d^2 / (2 * 1.5^2))

powerlaw12.label: power law, signed (B = 12)
powerlaw12.desc: random rotation of the spectrum k^-1, seed 0, tr Sigma = B (signed correlations)

powerlaw_pos12.label: power law, nonnegative (B = 12)
powerlaw_pos12.desc: sparse nonnegative factor model, factor variances k^-1, seed 0, tr Sigma = B

mnist49.label: MNIST pixels, 7×7 (B = 49, real)
mnist49.desc: covariance of MNIST training digits average-pooled to 7x7, scaled to unit mean variance
